findings.criterion: Live Bedrock proof before ship: a real gate-style recovery over multiple criteria where at least one evidence run exhausts completes with a verdict instead of failing whole (session experiment, not in unit suite).
findings.detail: No durable session artifact (script, log file, transcript, or experiment document) was found in the repository. The only record of the live Bedrock experiment is a ticket comment authored by RebarBotNava. The criterion explicitly requires a session experiment (not in unit suite), but no standalone repository artifact corroborates the live Bedrock run. The evidence gatherer explicitly confirmed: 'No session-experiment artifact file … was found in the repository under docs/, scripts/, or elsewhere.'
findings.remediation: Commit a session artifact (e.g., docs/experiments/bedrock_proof_ed6d.md or a .jsonl log) to the repository that records the live Bedrock run output, then reference it here.
findings.title: Live Bedrock proof exists only as a ticket comment, not as a durable repository artifact

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
